text:
emma_cs: FYI ACME opened a ticket — after last night's draft rollout their answers are coming back shorter and more 'confident' but with factual errors. They included three examples where the model invented dates and asserted incorrect ownership. Request IDs: req_0a1b, req_0a1c. Can we triage? :frowning:

raj_support: Thanks. Can you paste a minimal repro (prompt + output) and the request ID trace? Also which rollout did this — draft-optimizer v2 or the new decode pipeline?

emma_cs: Pasting one example below (customer removed sensitive data).
```
{
  "request_id": "req_0a1b",
  "model": "rw-infer-draft-2026",
  "input": "Who founded Acme Solar and when?",
  "response": "Acme Solar was founded by Jon Bates in 2012 and later acquired by GreenCorp in 2018."
}
```
Customer says the previous baseline would reply: "Acme Solar was founded in 2011 by Joanna Bates" (more cautious, with sources).

deploy-bot: deploy_id=deploy-2026-03-16-draft-v2 finished rollout to us-west at 2026-03-16T23:12Z. Config flags: speculative_decoding=true, draft_fallback=true, draft_threshold=0.6

olivia_ml: That rollout flipped speculative_decoding as a default in the rw-infer-draft family. That can increase aggressive token selection (more confident short answers). Any latency/throughput signals change? Also, did we change quantization or sampling defaults? :thinking:

matt_sre: Looking at infra metrics: no material P50/P95 change. Error budget saw a +0.3% increase in 5xx during that window (coincident with deploy). Not sure that explains hallucination behavior but noting it.

liz_eng: If the regression is customer-visible, propose two immediate mitigations: 1) route override to stable model for that customer 2) disable speculative_decoding on rw-infer-draft for the tenant until we diagnose. Who can flip the route override?

kevin_pm: CS to offer ACME either a targeted rollback or a tenant-level override and a postmortem. CS: confirm preference. @liz_eng can you prepare rollback plan and estimated ETA?

emma_cs: ACME asked for rollback unless we can show config is safe. I requested the route override already (route: acme-prod, model_override: rw-infer-stable-2026). Attached their sample eval set.

raj_support: I'll attempt a repro locally against rw-infer-draft-2026 with the same flags and seeds. ETA ~30m. Please leave the sample prompt and the request IDs unlocked.

olivia_ml: Reproducer notes — to match behavior run with identical sampling parameters. Example command: 
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
resp = client.generate(model='rw-infer-draft-2026', input='Who founded Acme Solar and when?', sampling={'speculative': True, 'temperature': 0.7, 'max_tokens': 80, 'seed': 42})
print(resp.text)
```
Collect token-level logprobs and the draft branch traces if possible. That will show whether speculative drafts are being accepted too early.

matt_sre: I applied a tenant route override: acme-prod -> rw-infer-stable-2026 at 1865432400. Traffic now routed. No deploy required.

emma_cs: ACME confirmed immediate improvement on the three sample prompts after the override. They're asking for root-cause and a per-customer mitigation plan. Thanks @matt_sre. /cc @olivia_ml @liz_eng

olivia_ml: Next steps from ML side: run an A/B on the customer's eval set comparing rw-infer-draft-2026 (speculative=true) vs rw-infer-stable-2026, export token-level logprobs and draft-decision traces, and check where draft acceptance threshold is too permissive. I'll own the analysis and iterate on draft_threshold and fallback policy.

emma_cs: I'll update the customer with the mitigation (route override) and ETA for root cause. Keeping ticket open until ML team confirms config fix.

raj_support: Repro ran — I can reproduce the aggressive short answers with speculative:true and seed 42. When I toggle speculative:false, responses match baseline. I've attached local logs (req repro ids: local-repro-77).

liz_eng: Good. Once OLivia posts the A/B numbers, we'll coordinate a safe config change and a staged roll forward. Recommend defaulting speculative_decoding=false for model family until patch is validated.

kevin_pm: Thanks team. CS will offer rollback/override as the mitigation and track for SLA credits if needed. Assigning follow-ups: Olivia -> analysis, Liz -> rollout plan, Raj -> reproduction artifacts, Matt -> tenant override ops.

emma_cs: Noted. I'll keep ACME updated and capture any additional failing prompts they send. :thumbsup:
